rules.title: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization Ordinance
rules.requirement: Landlords in Santa Ana cannot raise rent by more than 3% per year, or 80% of the CPI change if that is lower. If CPI is negative, no increase is allowed at all.
rules.key_value: Lower of 3% per year or 80% of CPI change
rules.coverage_conditions: Residential rental buildings, excluding those built after Feb 1, 1995, and mobile home spaces offered for rent after Jan 1, 1990.
rules.exemptions: Residential buildings constructed after February 1, 1995; mobile home spaces offered for rent after January 1, 1990.
rules.citation: Santa Ana Mun. Code, Rent Stabilization Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: Increase in residential rents are limited to the lower of 3% per year, or 80% of the percent change in the Consumer Price Index over the most recent 12-month period. If the CPI is negative, no rent increase is permitted.

coverage.other_unknown_factor: whether the unit is a mobile home space first offered for rent after January 1, 1990

rules.title: Santa Ana Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.requirement: After the first 30 days of tenancy, a landlord cannot evict a tenant without a legally recognized just cause, stated in writing. No-fault evictions (like owner move-in or demolition) require either 3 months of relocation assistance or 3 months of rent waived.
rules.key_value: 3 months relocation assistance or rent waiver for no-fault evictions
rules.coverage_conditions: Residential rental housing, excluding housing produced in the last 15 years, deed-restricted affordable housing, hotels/transient occupancy, hospitals/care facilities, dormitories, and other shared living quarters.
rules.exemptions: Housing produced in the last 15 years; deed-restricted affordable housing; hotel and transient occupancy; hospital and care facilities; dormitories; other shared living quarters.
rules.citation: Santa Ana Mun. Code, Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: After 30 days, an owner shall not terminate a tenancy without just cause, which shall be stated in a written notice.

coverage.other_unknown_factor: whether the unit is deed-restricted affordable housing, a hotel/transient occupancy, hospital/care facility, dormitory, or other shared living quarters
